content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Dallas

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Dallas professionals in defense, aerospace, and technology roles often qualify through a combination of formal education and documented hands-on leadership experience. Review PMI's specific thresholds before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Dallas-based instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours on a schedule that fits working professionals. You'll cover all five PMBOK process groups and earn your completion certificate upon finishing.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI with your education credentials, project experience, and completion certificate from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI examination fee at application. PMI will review your qualifications before you're authorized to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor review sessions. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center in the Dallas area. You'll have four hours to complete the computer-delivered PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities to help Dallas project managers stay current and retain certification.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
